scoring_justification: Cannot recompute the full DMFT simulation inside the checker; instead, verify structural properties of the final curves (abrupt jump, zero magnetization below threshold, approximate values within tolerances) against the paper's reported behavior.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference parameters for half-filling staggered magnetization curve and for doped magnetization/DOS curve at x=0.17, Δ=1.0t, derived from paper Fig.2 and solve.sh reference.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper's Fig.2 left panel and description of half-metallic behavior at x=0.17; solve.sh oracle uses piecewise linear approximation consistent with the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Piecewise linear model with threshold U_AF=2.0t, jump m_s=0.12, slope 0.04/t; doped window U1=2.0t to U2=3.6t, m_F_target=0.17, rho_threshold=1e-3.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Based on the published figure and physical expectation; solve.sh values are synthetic but correspond to a correct oracle that passes the checker at full reward.

units.U_t: dimensionless, normalized by hopping parameter t

outputs.description: Staggered magnetization m_s vs interaction strength U/t at half-filling for Δ=1.0t.

units.rho_up_0: density of states at Fermi level (arbitrary units)
units.rho_down_0: density of states at Fermi level (arbitrary units)

outputs.description: Uniform magnetization m_F and spin-resolved DOS at Fermi level vs U/t for doping x=0.17 and Δ=1.0t.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the computed values against reference data from the paper within tolerances. The gold reference data is hidden from the agent.
